title: Tooling config: golangci-lint + Biome + editorconfig
design:
Add repo-root configs for the lint/format tooling pinned in /grill-with-docs.

**`.golangci.yml`** — uses golangci-lint default linter set: govet, staticcheck, errcheck, goimports, ineffassign, unused, misspell. Set `run.timeout: 5m`, `issues.exclude-dirs: [src/frontend]`. Add a Makefile target `make lint` that runs `golangci-lint run ./...`.

**`biome.json`** — replaces ESLint + Prettier. Configure for React 19 + TS + Tailwind class sorting. Add npm scripts: `lint`, `format`, `check` (lint+format in one). Wire a pre-commit hook via `lefthook.yml` (simpler than husky, no Node-based runner needed; single binary) running `biome check` on changed files in src/frontend/ and `golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=HEAD~1` for changed Go files.

**`.editorconfig`** — LF line endings, UTF-8, 2-space indent (TS/JSON/YAML/MD), 4-space for Go files (per Go convention; matches gofmt).

**Verification:**
- `golangci-lint run ./...` exits 0 on the scaffolded repo.
- `npx biome check .` exits 0 on src/frontend/.
- `lefthook pre-commit` runs both on a staged file.

Blocked by: none (independent of code slices). Should run after h76 closes but before Wave 1 starts so all feature code lands already-linted.
acceptance_criteria:
exits 0 on the scaffolded repo and Checked 11 files in 20ms. No fixes applied.
Found 11 errors. exits 0 on src/frontend/. lefthook pre-commit hook runs both on staged files.

title: Implement app/ — assembly + Wails App constructor + binding stubs
design: Create src/backend/app/app.go (App struct holding pointers to all services, New(ctx) constructor that initializes core/crypto + core/catalog + platform/events + features/recovery, returns *App), bindings.go thin re-export file (no methods here — each binding lives in bindings_<feature>.go). Create app/bindings_recovery.go as the only binding stub for now: HandleMissingKey() Decision exposed to frontend. main.go in repo root does embed src/frontend/dist and calls wails.Run with &options.App{Bind: app.New(ctx)}.
acceptance_criteria: go build ./... && go test ./app/... passes (recovery flow tested via mock). wails dev starts a window with a sidebar nav stub. The frontend can call window.go.main.App.HandleMissingKey() and get back a Decision.

title: Implement features/profile/ — Server Profile CRUD
design: Create src/backend/features/profile/service.go (Service struct + CreateProfile, ListProfiles, UpdateProfile, DeleteProfile that delegate to core/catalog), types.go (Profile struct with plain Host/Port/User/SSL fields — password never leaves the service boundary in plaintext, returned via a Tokenized view). Bindings in app/bindings_profile.go. Per ARCHITECTURE.md, profile may be imported by features/restore, features/backup, features/recovery.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./features/profile/... passes against in-memory SQLite. Bindings ListServerProfiles/CreateServerProfile/UpdateServerProfile/DeleteServerProfile callable from frontend (verified via wails dev with a manual smoke or a frontend test).

title: Implement features/recovery/ — Smart Recovery modal + Reset policy
design: Create src/backend/features/recovery/modal.go (ShowMissingKeyModal(ctx, events) (Decision, error) using platform/events to emit a 'recovery:show' event and wait for a 'recovery:decision' event), recovery.go (HandleMissingKey(ctx, crypto.Store, catalog.Store, events) that calls modal and on Reset wipes catalog + regenerates key, on Cancel returns user-facing error). Imports core/crypto and core/catalog. No other features/.
acceptance_criteria: Test simulates missing app.key, calls HandleMissingKey with a mock event bus that returns Decision=Cancel — service returns ErrUserCancelled. Decision=Reset — catalog.Wipe is called and crypto key regenerated.

title: Implement platform/events/ — Wails event emitter primitive
design: Create src/backend/platform/events/events.go with Emit(ctx, name string, payload any) and Subscribe(name string) (<-chan Event, func() unsubscribe). Thin wrapper around Wails runtime.EventsEmit / EventsOn. No business logic. No import from features/.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./platform/events/... passes with a mock emitter. Emitting + subscribing in same test goroutine receives the event with the correct payload.

title: Implement core/crypto/ — AES-GCM primitives + app.key lifecycle
design: Create src/backend/core/crypto/aesgcm.go (NewKey, Encrypt, Decrypt using AES-256-GCM, nonce-prepended ciphertext) and src/backend/core/crypto/appkey.go (LoadKey from app.key beside executable, GenerateKey to create a new 256-bit key, ErrMissingKey sentinel). Tests in aesgcm_test.go using fixed test vectors. No Wails import. No SQLite import.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./src/backend/core/crypto/... passes without any other package. Encrypt then Decrypt roundtrips. Missing app.key returns ErrMissingKey. GenerateKey creates a 32-byte file.

title: Implement core/catalog/ — SQLite store with AES-GCM credentials table
design: Create src/backend/core/catalog/catalog.go (Store struct + Open/Close, opens catalog.sqlite beside executable using modernc.org/sqlite pure-Go driver), schema.go (CREATE TABLE profiles with encrypted host/port/user/password/ssl fields using crypto package), credentials.go (SaveProfile/LoadProfile that calls crypto.Encrypt/Decrypt on sensitive fields). Tests use in-memory SQLite. No Wails import.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./src/backend/core/catalog/... passes. A profile roundtrips through SaveProfile + LoadProfile with credentials encrypted at rest (verify by reading raw SQLite row — password field is ciphertext, not plaintext).

title: Implement core/scanner/ — single-pass Byte-Offset Scanner
design: Create src/backend/core/scanner/scanner.go (Scanner struct + Scan(path string) error that opens the file, reads via bufio.Scanner line-by-line, detects CREATE TABLE / INSERT INTO / USE statements and records {StartByte, EndByte, ObjectType, ObjectName, DatabaseName} via offset.go type Offset struct). Pure stdlib bufio + os. No Wails, no SQLite. The catalog population is NOT this issue's job — scanner returns []Object, caller persists.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./core/scanner/... passes with a fixture dump file containing 2 databases x 3 tables each. Offset coordinates match those recorded by mariadb-dump --skip-comments. Memory stays flat (read with -memprofile and confirm no large slice allocations beyond the result).

title: Implement core/streamer/ — Virtual Streamer + Definer Stripper + ProgressReader
design: Create src/backend/core/streamer/streamer.go (VirtualStream struct + Build(header, selectedSections []scanner.Offset, footer string) io.Reader using io.MultiReader), definer.go (DefinerStripper io.Reader wrapper that rewrites DEFINER=user@host to DEFINER=CURRENT_USER using a streaming regex/parser — never buffers the whole stream), progress.go (ProgressReader with atomic byte counter, NOT Wails-aware — emits via a callback func(bytesSoFar, totalBytes int64)). Tests with synthetic io.Pipe data. core/streamer imports core/scanner for the Offset type only.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./core/streamer/... passes. A stream assembled from header + 2 section readers + footer reads the bytes in correct order. DefinerStripper rewrites a fixture DEFINER clause without buffering more than 8KB. ProgressReader counts match io.Copy output.

title: Initialize Wails v2 scaffold with src/ layout
design:
Run `wails init -n mariadb-restore-desktop-app -t react-ts` into a scratch dir, then move `main.go`, `wails.json`, `go.mod`, `app.go` (default app bootstrap) to repo root. Move `frontend/` to `src/frontend/`. Edit `wails.json` so frontend:install = `npm --prefix src/frontend install` and frontend:build = `npm --prefix src/frontend run build`. Edit `main.go` embed directive to `//go:embed all:src/frontend/dist`. Verify with `wails dev` that the empty app window opens.

**Library pins (from /grill-with-docs session, 2026-08-28) — bake these into go.mod / package.json during scaffold:**

Go (`go.mod`):
- `github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2 v2.15.x` — framework (latest stable v2)
- `modernc.org/sqlite` — pure-Go SQLite driver (no CGO; Ubuntu 24.04 / Windows cross-compile friendly)
- `github.com/gofrs/uuid` — UUIDv4 for Server Profile IDs and Catalog row IDs
- `golang.org/x/sync` — errgroup for multi-DB sequential subprocess (ADR-0006)
- `github.com/stretchr/testify` — Go test assertions
- Stdlib only: `crypto/aes`, `crypto/cipher`, `crypto/rand` (AES-256-GCM), `encoding/base64`, `bufio`, `io`, `os`, `os/exec`, `context`, `database/sql`, `log/slog`, `net/http` (only if/when needed)

Frontend (`package.json`):
- `react@^19`, `react-dom@^19`
- `@tanstack/react-virtual` — virtual scroll (>10k-table schema grid)
- `react-hook-form@^7`, `zod@^4`, `@hookform/resolvers`
- `tailwindcss@^4`, `@tailwindcss/vite` — Tailwind v4
- `lucide-react` — icons (shadcn/ui expectation; bundled tree-shaken)
- `@radix-ui/*` primitives — needed by shadcn/ui (dialog, dropdown, slot)
- `class-variance-authority`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge` — shadcn/ui utilities
- Dev: `vite`, `typescript`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `vitest`, `@testing-library/react`, `jsdom`, `@testing-library/jest-dom`, `biome` (lint+format, replaces ESLint+Prettier), `tailwindcss-animate`

**Build / OS:**
- Linux: `wails build -tags webkit2_41` (required on Ubuntu 24.04; Ubuntu ships WebKitGTK 4.1, not 4.0)
- Windows: `wails build -webview2 embed` (no runtime install needed)
- Bundled MariaDB: 10.11 LTS line

**Do NOT install:**
- `mattn/go-sqlite3` (CGO)
- `resty` / `req` (no HTTP in v1)
- `prometheus/client_golang` or OpenTelemetry (YAGNI v1)
- `react-window` / `react-virtualized` (TanStack Virtual supersedes both)
- ESLint + Prettier (Biome replaces both)

Acceptance: same as before, plus `go mod tidy` shows only the pinned deps and `npm ls --depth=0` shows only the pinned frontend deps (no surprise transitive bulking beyond Tailwind/shadcn/Radix peer deps).
acceptance_criteria: Repo root has main.go, wails.json, go.mod, go.sum. src/frontend/ has package.json + Vite config. wails dev opens the default window. go build ./... passes. No code in src/backend/ yet — only the folder structure laid out in src/backend/ARCHITECTURE.md (empty placeholders or a .gitkeep file).
